parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A cabinet door made of MDF, rectangular in shape, forming one of the front panels of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a movable cover to enclose and protect the contents of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A lower cabinet door made of MDF, rectangular and hinged to the frame.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the lower storage compartment of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: An upper cabinet door made of MDF, rectangular and smooth-surfaced.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the upper storage section of the cabinet to conceal items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A matching cabinet door made of MDF, forming part of the front enclosure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides closure and aesthetic uniformity to the cabinet front.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, forming the outer box and support structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the doors and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving component providing rigidity to the cabinet.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal shelf made of particle board, rectangular and flat.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items within the cabinet compartments.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable vertically within the frame.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf made of particle board, providing internal storage division.
parts.Functional_description: It separates storage spaces and supports items placed on it.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable vertically within the cabinet frame.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: An upper shelf made of particle board, flat and rectangular.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space for lighter items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable vertically within the cabinet frame.
